title: The Lightstep and OpenCensus telemetry providers are deprecated and removed in 1.27

detection.reason: extension providers live inside the istio ConfigMap's mesh YAML, whose keys the projection keeps and whose contents it does not

quote: The telemetry providers Lightstep and Opencensus are deprecated and will be removed in next release(v1.27). Please consider using the OpenTelemetry provider instead.
remediation: Replace `lightstep` entries in `meshConfig.extensionProviders` with an `opentelemetry` provider pointed at the same collector and repoint Telemetry resources at it before moving to 1.27, where Lightstep stops producing a tracer; `opencensus` providers have produced no tracer since 1.23 and can go now.
verifyCommand: kubectl get cm -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.data.mesh != null) | (.metadata.namespace + "/" + .metadata.name) as $n | .data.mesh | split("\n")[] | select(test("lightstep|opencensus")) | $n + ": " + .'  # a printed line configures a provider 1.27 removes

title: ztunnel chart resources default back to the static name `ztunnel` — a 1.25 install that adopted the release name renames again

detection.reason: the Helm release name and any resourceName override are release inputs; the ztunnel DaemonSet's name is what changes

quote: In this release, we have reverted to default to a static `ztunnel` name again. As previously, this can be overriden with `--set resourceName=my-custom-name`.
remediation: If the 1.25 upgrade left the ztunnel DaemonSet named after a non-`ztunnel` release (without `resourceName`), the 1.26 upgrade renames it back to `ztunnel`, recreating the DaemonSet; pass `--set resourceName=<current name>` to keep it, or plan the brief ambient interruption.
verifyCommand: kubectl get ds -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select([.spec.template.spec.containers[].image] | any(test("(istio|istio-release)/ztunnel"))) | select(.metadata.name != "ztunnel") | .metadata.namespace + "/" + .metadata.name'  # a printed DaemonSet is not named ztunnel and is renamed by the 1.26 chart unless resourceName is set

title: `ENABLE_AUTO_SNI` is removed — automatic SNI can no longer be turned off

detection.reason: checked on the istiod Deployment's container env NAMES only — a flag set through `pilot.env` in a values file lands there; one set via `meshConfig` or an IstioOperator that has not been applied yet is not scanned

remediation: Remove the variable from istiod. If it was `false`, TLS-originating DestinationRules without an explicit `sni` start sending the request host as SNI at 1.26; set `tls.sni` explicitly on upstreams that must receive a fixed name.
verifyCommand: kubectl get deploy -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select([.spec.template.spec.containers[].image] | any(test("(istio|istio-release)/pilot"))) | (.metadata.namespace + "/" + .metadata.name) as $n | .spec.template.spec.containers[].env[]? | select(.name | test("^(ENABLE_AUTO_SNI)$")) | $n + ": " + .name + "=" + (.value // "(valueFrom)")'  # a printed line is the removed flag; a value of false means auto-SNI turns on at 1.26

title: The istio-cni node agent no longer runs with `hostNetwork`

detection.reason: a chart default that changes the node agent's pod spec; the DaemonSet is the subject

quote: **Improved** The CNI agent to no longer require `hostNetwork`, improving compatibility. Dynamic switching to the host network is now performed whenever necessary. The old behavior can temporarily be restored by setting the `ambient.shareHostNetworkNamespace` field in the `istio-cni` chart.
remediation: No action on a stock install. NetworkPolicies or node firewall rules written for a host-network `istio-cni-node` pod must allow the pod-network pod instead; `ambient.shareHostNetworkNamespace=true` on the istio-cni chart restores the old placement temporarily.
verifyCommand: kubectl get ds -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select([.spec.template.spec.containers[].image] | any(test("(istio|istio-release)/install-cni"))) | .metadata.namespace + "/" + .metadata.name + " hostNetwork=" + ((.spec.template.spec.hostNetwork // false) | tostring)'  # hostNetwork=true before the upgrade becomes false after it unless shareHostNetworkNamespace is set
